NB. NICHE RECRUITMENT-Cut off marks is 300 Marks
 1. FGM Champions-We have mobilized through the Anti FGM Board to collect data from County Anti FGM steering Board as chaired by
 County Commissioner. Branches to engage with the County Commissioners.
 2. Teen Mothers- We have mobilized through the National Council for Population and Development (NCPD) to collect data from County
 Anti Board as chaired by County Commissioner.
 3. Persons with Disability (PWD)-We have mobilized through the national Council for Persons with disability (NCPWD). 10% of the
 county allocation has been reserved for PWD.
